releaseOverride: Classification research/prototype priority only; no change to MVP release scope or gallery capacity

features.behavior: Future backend validates upload then creates evidence tied to subject, household, owner, contributor and consent
features.acceptance: Three allowed modalities; MIME, dimensions, size, final ASR and closed fields validated; inactive/cross-scope input refused
features.gap: Upload API, actual checksum verification, object store, ACL service and physical deletion are not implemented

features.behavior: Future UI can show multi-facet candidates, source references, conflicts and review states
features.acceptance: Fake success/review/conflict/partial failure preserve candidate states and every requested facet outcome; no automatic identity confirmation
features.gap: No real extraction, accuracy result, gallery classification UI or released product feature

features.behavior: Future backend can classify final ASR asynchronously and show stable failure/retry states
features.acceptance: Partial ASR and raw audio rejected; timeout/cancel/errors return stable codes; late results rejected
features.gap: Existing realtime voice chain is unchanged; no ASR integration or job persistence implemented

features.behavior: Future subject or authorized proxy can confirm/edit/reject/withdraw candidates using revision and authority references
features.acceptance: Review request schema supports four actions; provider cannot return confirmed/edited/rejected/withdrawn as human decisions
features.gap: Review service, authorization/revision concurrency checks and Memory adapter remain unimplemented; no Canonical Memory write

features.behavior: Backend receives stable error codes without provider diagnostic text or permission-changing output
features.acceptance: Unknown output fields, cross-scope refs, invalid versions and stale evidence are rejected; secret scan is clean
features.gap: No product event pipeline, full IDOR E2E, research export or deletion propagation verification
